description:
Calculate Systolic Pressure Variation (SPV) manually from the arterial waveform in Vital Recorder.

Context: You are analyzing a patient's fluid responsiveness. You need to measure the 'swing' in arterial blood pressure caused by mechanical ventilation.

Task:
1. Open Vital Recorder with Case #3 ('0003.vital') loaded.
2. Navigate to the time window 00:45:00 - 00:45:15 (45 minutes into the case).
3. Find the 'Solar8000/ART' (Arterial Pressure) waveform track.
4. Identify the maximum systolic peak pressure and the minimum systolic peak pressure within this 15-second window.
5. Calculate SPV = Max SBP - Min SBP.
6. Create a report at 'C:\Users\Docker\Documents\spv_calculation.txt' with the format:
   SPV REPORT
   Time Window: 00:45:00 - 00:45:15
   Max SBP: [Value] mmHg
   Min SBP: [Value] mmHg
   Calculated SPV: [Value] mmHg

7. Take a screenshot of the waveform view used for calculation and save it to 'C:\Users\Docker\Pictures\spv_waveform.png'.
